text: Vodafone Group Plc, a London-listed telecoms group, confirmed on 10 July 2026 that e& agreed to sell its entire stake to Vega, a vehicle of the Niel family; whether the sale has since completed and whether Niel became the largest shareholder are reported elsewhere (Reuters, e& H1 2026 results) and not verified against this URL.

source.name: Vodafone 'Response to e&'s announcement'; Reuters (Niel becomes Vodafone's top shareholder); e& H1 2026 results (sale completed)
source.quote: e& has agreed to dispose of its entire shareholding in Vodafone to Vega, an acquisition vehicle wholly owned by the Niel family group.
